title: 第五十三章 见隙第五十二章 山地精与熊人族下
lines: 西隆在蛇眼湖畔度过一夜，天亮之后，他并未应邀去往熊人山寨，而是带着幼龙们转向东方，探索蛮骨氏族的营地。
山地精果然居住在台地峡谷之间，在峭壁上开凿出大量山洞，依靠麻绳木板搭建的栈道相连。
西隆、莫奇和比多还好，面对这样的环境，克莱利根本找不到下脚的地方，钴龙沉重的身体，也不支持他在近乎垂直的山壁上攀登。
不过克莱利本身就懒得动，西隆干脆让钴龙拽住山地精头领，在峡谷下方呆着，自己则和比多、莫奇绕着蛮骨氏族的聚居地，四处察看一番。
“对了。”
莫奇带着好奇，凑到西隆身边：“还没有问，你是怎么知道那个使者就是山地精头领的？你那一番话说完，那个山地精战士的脸色完全变了，今天这一路走来，感觉蛮骨氏族对我们的态度都尊敬很多。”
“我不知道，是熊人氏族告诉我的。”
西隆说：“昨天那场会面，我注意到熊人族看向山地精的神情，他们的神情堪称蔑视，可唯独在看那个使者的时候，出现了敌意和仇恨。”
“我想他们应该很早之前就认识了，加上另外两个山地精战士的忠诚环护、使者本身的言行举止和旺盛血气，我判断他不是什么小角色。”
“太厉害了。”
莫奇由衷赞叹：“换我怎么也看不出来。”
“龙之传承教导，在荒野之间行走的铬龙，应当掌握三种能力：观刃、照影和见隙，这是我们赖以生存和强大的本领。”
西隆看了莫奇一眼：“你知道是什么意思吗？”
莫奇摇了摇头：“我虽然有传承，但是还没有领悟，西隆你教我吧。”
“换作浅白简短的话解释，观刃是认识自己的力量、照影是洞察自己的缺陷，见隙指观察周围的环境、事物的变化。”
西隆说：“龙之传承里说，每天保持这样的修行，像打磨刀刃一样磨砺自身，它们便会逐渐固化成三种具体的能力，让铬龙维持上位种的优势地位，也不畏惧其他天敌的侵袭。”
“从结果上来说，观刃可以提升爪牙的锋利程度，照影能够强化我们的体魄和刚性，不过，趁着这个机会，今天重点让你体会一下见隙的修行。”
莫奇呆呆的点头。
西隆在山洞里踱步，把地上的火堆拨开，看了看那些干柴：“你看，这些柴火还没有燃尽，直接被扑灭了，底下还有余温，说明这座山洞里的山地精，并没有离开很久。”
他迈步走向角落：“这里有堆放物品的痕迹，形制像个背篓，是用来盛放泥炭的，周围洒了一些碎屑。”
“泥炭是很劣质的煤炭，点起来黑烟滚滚，但对于这些山地精来说，也算比较珍贵的物资，他们没收拾这些碎屑，看来走得还是比较急。”
莫奇若有所思：“因为我们的到来，所以提前逃走么？”
“不能说是逃走。”
西隆摇了摇头：“逃走是慌不择路的，留下的场地必定混乱，可我们一路看过来的山洞都很利落，除了这里洒了一些泥炭，该放弃的一概不拿，值钱的东西一样没剩，这不是逃走而是撤退，甚至是十分熟练、有序的撤退。”
西隆抬头看了山洞几眼，又跟随地上的脚印，一路走到外面：“这个山洞很大，堆放的东西也多，应该是山地精平时集会的地方，不久之前，有人在这里把山地精召集起来，下达了紧急撤退的命令，接着他们搬了东西、踩灭篝火，依次离开。”
莫奇目瞪口呆。
西隆说：“见隙要求平时保持敏锐的观察，形成能力之后，可以在战斗中迅速找到对方的弱点，如果更进一步，甚至可以看见血气和魔力的流动，出手将其截断。”
莫奇认认真真记下，接着又忍不住问：“按照这样的说法，西隆你是已经掌握了‘见隙’吗？”
content_en:
Shillong spent the night by the Snake Eye Lake. After dawn, he did not accept the invitation to go to the Bear Man Village. Instead, he took the young dragons to the east and explored the camp of the Barbarian Bone Clan.
As expected, the mountain elves live among the mesas and canyons. They have carved out a large number of caves on the cliffs and connected them with plank roads built with hemp ropes and planks.
Shillong, Mochi and Bido were fine. Faced with such an environment, Clery couldn't find a place to put his feet. The heavy body of the cobalt dragon did not support him in climbing on the nearly vertical mountain wall.
However, Clery himself was too lazy to move. Shillong simply asked the cobalt dragon to grab the mountain goblin leader and stay below the canyon, while he, Bido and Mochi walked around the settlement of the Barbarian Bone Clan and looked around.
"Right."
Moqi approached Shillong with curiosity: "I haven't asked yet, how did you know that the messenger was the mountain goblin leader? After you said what you said, the face of the mountain goblin warrior completely changed. Along the way today, I feel that the Barbarian Bone Clan treats us with a lot of respect."
"I don't know, the Ursine clan told me."
Shillong said: "In yesterday's meeting, I noticed the way the bear tribe looked at the mountain goblins. Their expressions could be described as contempt, but only when they looked at the messenger, there was hostility and hatred."
"I think they should have known each other a long time ago. Coupled with the loyal protection of the other two mountain goblin warriors, the messenger's own words, deeds, and strong blood, I judge that he is not a small role."
"It's amazing."
Mo Qi admired sincerely: "I wouldn't have been able to tell."
"Dragon inheritance teaches that chromium dragons walking in the wilderness should master three abilities: observing blades, taking photos, and seeing gaps. These are the skills that we rely on for survival and strength."
Shillong glanced at Mochi: "Do you know what it means?"
Mo Qi shook his head: "Although I have the inheritance, I haven't realized it yet. Shillong, please teach me."
"To explain it in simple words, observing the blade means understanding one's own strength, taking a photo means observing one's own shortcomings, and seeing gaps means observing the surrounding environment and changes in things."
Shillong said: "It is said in the dragon heritage that by practicing this way every day and sharpening oneself like a blade, they will gradually solidify into three specific abilities, allowing the chrome dragon to maintain its superior status as a superior species and not be afraid of the invasion of other natural enemies."
"In terms of results, observing the blade can improve the sharpness of the minions, and taking the shadow can strengthen our body and rigidity. However, taking this opportunity, today I will focus on letting you experience the practice of seeing the gap."
Mochi nodded blankly.
Shillong walked in the cave, pushed the fire on the ground away, and looked at the dry firewood: "Look, these firewoods were put out before they burned out. There is still residual warmth underneath, which means that the mountain goblins in this cave have not left for a long time."
He stepped towards the corner: "There are traces of stacked items here. It is shaped like a backpack and is used to hold peat. There are some debris scattered around."
"Peat is a very low-quality coal, and when it is lit, black smoke billows, but for these mountain elves, it is also a relatively precious material. They did not collect these debris, so it seems that they left in a hurry."
Mo Qi thought thoughtfully: "Did you escape early because of our arrival?"
"It can't be said to be an escape."
Shillong shook his head: "Escape is done in a hurry, and the place left behind must be chaotic. However, the caves we have seen along the way are very clean. Except for some peat sprinkled here, we did not take anything that should be given up. There is no valuable thing left. This is not an escape but a retreat, even a very skilled and orderly retreat."
Shillong looked up at the cave for a few times, then followed the footprints on the ground and walked all the way outside: "This cave is very big and has a lot of things piled up. It should be the place where the mountain goblins usually gather. Not long ago, someone summoned the mountain goblins here and issued an emergency retreat order. Then they moved the things, put out the bonfire, and left one by one."
Mochi was stunned.
Shillong said: "Seeing gaps requires you to maintain keen observation at all times. After forming the ability, you can quickly find the opponent's weaknesses in the battle. If you go one step further, you can even see the flow of blood and magic power and cut it off."
Mo Qi took note of it carefully, and then he couldn't help but ask: "According to this statement, Shillong, have you mastered the 'gap'?"
title_en: Chapter 53: Gap Chapter 52: Mountain Goblins and Bearmen
